findings.name: UnpinnedDataset
findings.message: The dataset 'demo@latest' follows the newest data: two runs of the same code can read different data.
findings.fix: Pin a version: use <dataset>@v1 (a released version) instead of @latest, so a run always reads the same data.

findings.name: NodeSharing
findings.message: Step 'train' declares no time limit, so it cannot be offered as a guest on a node another job already holds on the HPC (Slurm) site.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix. Set walltime, for example walltime='4h', to let the step share a node.

findings.name: RefusedArgument
findings.message: step() has no argument 'walltime', so the render fails.
findings.fix: Use walltime for the HPC (Slurm) time limit.

findings.name: IdleTimeoutOff
findings.message: Step 'train' turns the idle limit off. A hung step keeps its GPU, and its budget, until the time limit.
findings.fix: Remove idle_timeout=0 to keep the default (a step with no GPU use and no new log line for 20 minutes is ended), or raise it, for example idle_timeout='40m'.
